_notes.title: The page's name, shown at the top and in the browser tab.
_notes.players: Who plays each side. Black moves first. Write a name, or "computer" to make that side the computer; at most one side can be the computer. Two names make it a game for two people on one screen.
_notes.strength: How hard the computer plays: 1 is Easy, 2 is Club, 3 is Master.
_notes.theme: The table: "lacquer-green" (ivory and black on green), "walnut" (cream and espresso on wood), or "neon" (cyan and magenta on black glass).
_notes.sound: true plays the disc sounds; false keeps the table quiet.
